rationale: Neither AHB IHI 0033C nor APB IHI 0024C defines a JTAG / scan / BIST / MBIST / debug architecture. There is no dedicated debug interface in either protocol. Debug visibility, if any, must be added by the integrator (e.g. ARM CoreSight components) outside these specs.

spec_provided_observability_ahb.name: HRESP error response
spec_provided_observability_ahb.purpose: Two-cycle ERROR observable by Manager and monitoring logic.

spec_provided_observability_ahb.name: HEXOKAY (AHB5)
spec_provided_observability_ahb.purpose: Indicates success / failure of Exclusive Transfer.

spec_provided_observability_ahb.name: User signaling HxUSER (AHB5)
spec_provided_observability_ahb.purpose: Implementation-defined extras for debug / trace / functional augmentation.

spec_provided_observability_ahb.name: Interface protection using parity (AHB5)
spec_provided_observability_ahb.purpose: Single-bit fault detection on each interface.

spec_provided_observability_ahb.name: Default Subordinate ERROR for unmapped addresses

spec_provided_observability_apb.name: PSLVERR (APB3+)
spec_provided_observability_apb.purpose: Failure indicator at end of transfer; mapped to AHB HRESP=ERROR / AXI RRESP=SLVERR by an upstream bridge.

ahb_optional_features_per_property.Write_Strobes: Adds HWSTRB to the interface for sparse-write support
ahb_optional_features_per_property.Secure_Transfers: Adds HNONSEC; supports Secure / Non-secure distinction
ahb_optional_features_per_property.Exclusive_Transfers: Adds HEXCL + HMASTER + HEXOKAY; supports Exclusive Access Monitor
ahb_optional_features_per_property.Extended_Memory_Types: Widens HPROT to 7 bits for extended memory-type encoding
ahb_optional_features_per_property.User_Request_Width: HAUSER width on the address channel (issuer-defined)
ahb_optional_features_per_property.User_Data_Width: HWUSER / HRUSER widths on the data channels
ahb_optional_features_per_property.User_Response_Width: HBUSER width on the response channel
ahb_optional_features_per_property.Parity_Property: Enables interface protection using parity check signals

ahb_recommendations_on_user_signals: Spec recommends User signals are used only for point-to-point Manager-Subordinate communication; they are not propagated by generic interconnect components and present an interoperability risk if used elsewhere.
